description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_IDAccumulator, which manages a collection of IDs to ensure uniqueness within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains methods for building an instance with configs, adding IDs, and loading a list of IDs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_IDAccumulator
classes.description: A class that accumulates and manages a set of IDs to prevent duplicates during HTML purification.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Factory method that creates and initializes an IDAccumulator with a blacklist of IDs from the configuration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new ID to the lookup table; returns false if the ID already exists.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a list of IDs into the accumulator, marking each as present.
